ASI (asi-globalpartitions.com/find-a-rep): no Pennsylvania entries in the fetched HTML.
Scranton Products where-to-buy: worked, but it lists only one territory sales rep for all of PA (not an installer), so no candidate came from it.
Bradley, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco: not tried (fetch budget spent on leads).
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): 403 on direct fetch. Only search snippets were usable (Braden & McSweeny, Dubin & Co project).
Houzz (Bathroom Solutions): worked, but residential only, so not included.
Yelp: not reachable through the seed links; skipped.
cisleads.com: worked. It found Tristate Material Services (Malvern PA) and Widener Inc. (Fairless Hills PA), both eastern PA and beyond 120 miles, so not included.
Kelley Bros: worked. It installs Division 10, but its locations page has no Pittsburgh office (PA offices are Clarks Summit and Center Valley), so not included.

Builders Door & Hardware (Allentown PA), Hostetter Supply (Seven Valleys PA, serves south-central PA), Construction Specialties Installations (NY/NH/FL) and Partition Plus (Maryland, installs not confirmed): checked, all outside the area, not included.
onepointpartitions.com Pittsburgh page: 403. Search snippets show it ships for customers to install themselves, so it is not an installer.

WebSearch: 8 of 8 used. The queries were Division 10 Pittsburgh, toilet partitions installer western PA, bathroom partitions installer Pittsburgh, Division 10 specialties installer Pittsburgh, nearby towns (Bridgeville, Monroeville, Cranberry, Washington, Greensburg), western PA counties, and Pittsburgh, Wheeling, Morgantown and Youngstown. The results kept returning the same few firms (Braden & McSweeny, Dubin, One Point Partitions), and the cap was reached.

candidates.name: Braden & McSweeny, Inc.
candidates.base_city: Pittsburgh area (Carnegie); second office Westlake, OH
candidates.partition_evidence: Services page: 'Manufacturer certified to install all of our Toilet Partitions, Toilet Room Accessories, and Lockers'; homepage lists Toilet Partitions; 'Division 10 since 1964'.
red_flags: Distributor that stocks and sells toilet partitions (claims largest stock in Western PA): high buy-around risk
candidates.reason: Long-running Pittsburgh Division 10 distributor that installs the toilet partitions it sells. Strong installer, but a direct competitor on partition supply.

license.name: Braden & McSweeny, Inc.
license.registry: City of Pittsburgh PLI Licensed Contractors (WPRDC open data, 'Business, Contractors & Trades' dataset, resource 7e195511-5219-4d16-84f7-f34a2aedf5b4, updated 2026-11-19)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. No record for 'Braden' or 'McSweeny' among 5,652 current and historical City of Pittsburgh contractor licenses, or in the city's business and trade license tables. Under Pittsburgh's rule, it would need a City general contractor license to work under a commercial building permit inside city limits. Its base, Carnegie, is outside the city, so a license is needed only for jobs in Pittsburgh. The company site lists toilet partitions and toilet room accessories but gives no license number or office city on the homepage. PA Home Improvement Contractor registration (Office of Attorney General, hic.attorneygeneral.gov) could not be checked because the site returned HTTP 503. That registration covers residential work only, so it is not the relevant rule for commercial partitions.
